name: Akiyama Sou
source:
Sou is a second-year student in class B and a member of the astronomy club at Uchihama Academy. Both his father and mother are scientists and are authorities on mechanical engineering. He lives in his childhood friend [url=/c474]Kaori's[/url] house as his parents work overseas. He is interested in astronomy, and plans build a planetarium for the school festival.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/In_Search_of_the_Lost_Future]Wikipedia[/url]]
